referenceDna.annotatedDescription: The official Concept Pro Painting South Florida homepage was inspected in paired desktop and mobile full-page captures. The page opens with a low-light exterior-home photograph anchors a dark charcoal layout with a floating quote form. It uses minimal charcoal service links and light estimate controls. The visual system relies on clean geometric sans with large centered statements and compact utility labels; surfaces include near-black, charcoal, off-white and accents include soft teal, pale blue. Imagery is darkened finished-home scenes, before-and-after slider, interior projects, and social project images. The page then runs through dark image and form hero, horizontal service strip, four service cards, before-and-after comparison, interior feature, recent work, four-step process, reviews, service-area map, social work collage, FAQ and contact. Its service presentation is compact dark service cards followed by a visual before-and-after comparison. Mobile changes to stack form and images, keep comparison usable by touch, and make the service list readable without horizontal drag. Transfer only the layout rhythm and decision path. Do not copy Concept Pro identity, before-and-after photos, review text, ratings, guarantee, same-day reply, or property images.
